Group statistics and limit of detection

Source: R/tidyMS_missingness_imputation.R
MissingHelpers.Rd

Group statistics and limit of detection

Group statistics and limit of detection

Value

An R6 class generator.

Details

Computes per-group statistics of the abundances and, from them, the limit of detection (LOD) used by build_model_impute to impute groups without observations.

Public fields

data

data

config

config

prob

quantile of groups with one observed value to estimate LOD

stats

data.frame with group statistics

Method get_lod()

determine limit of detection computes quantile of abundances in groups with a single observation; without such groups, of the partly observed groups with the fewest observations, and when every group is complete or empty, the lowest group mean

Usage

MissingHelpers$get_lod()

Returns

numeric LOD

Examples

dd <- prolfqua::sim_lfq_data_protein_config(Nprot = 100,weight_missing = 2)
#> creating sampleName from file_name column
#> completing cases
#> completing cases done
#> setup done
mh <- prolfqua::MissingHelpers$new(dd$data, dd$config, prob = 0.8)
xx <- mh$get_stats()
xx <- mh$get_lod()

dd <- prolfqua::sim_lfq_data_2factor_config(Nprot = 100,weight_missing = 0.1)
#> creating sampleName from file_name column
#> completing cases
#> completing cases done
#> setup done
mh <- prolfqua::MissingHelpers$new(dd$data, dd$config, prob = 0.8)
mh$get_stats()$interaction |> table()
#> 
#> TreatmentA:BackgroundX TreatmentB:BackgroundX TreatmentA:BackgroundZ 
#>                    100                    100                    100 
#> TreatmentB:BackgroundZ             TreatmentA             TreatmentB 
#>                    100                    100                    100 
#>            BackgroundX            BackgroundZ 
#>                    100                    100 
mh$get_lod()
#> [1] 15.24351
